content: Ibn Turka says he will present the verse, likened to a veiled bride awaiting in the Prophetic pavilion, according to the usage of each group of travellers on perfection's highway, unfurling it according to its seven meanings, on the dictum that the Quran has seven layers of hiddenness.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
